question: At the time of its adoption, the Constitution contained 395 Articles and _______ Schedules.
solution:
The correct answer is __**8**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• At the time of its adoption on **26th November 1949**, the Indian Constitution contained **395 Articles** divided across 22 Parts and 8 Schedules.
 
• The 8 Schedules included provisions related to subjects such as distribution of powers, languages, administration of tribal areas, and allocation of seats in legislatures.
